\section{Spoectroscopy Areas}
\begin{itemize} \item Atomic spectroscopy \item Emission spectroscopy \item Electron spectroscopy, including Auger spectroscopy \item Electron spin resonance \item \emph{Fourier transform spectroscopy and imaging} \item \emph{Fluorescence spectroscopy}, including Fluorescence Correlation Spectroscopy (FCS) and Fluorescence Cross-Correlation Spectroscopy (FCCS) \item Gamma spectroscopy \item \emph{Infrared spectroscopy (IR)} \item Laser induced breakdown spectroscopy \item Mass spectrometry (MS) \item \PMlinkexternal{microspectroscopy:}{http://planetphysics.org/?op=getobj&from=lec&id=186} including fluorescence/FLIM, IR and \emph{NIR microspectroscopy} \item Nanospectroscopy \item $M\ddot{o}ssbauer$ spectroscopy \item \emph{Near Infrared spectroscopy (NIR)} \item Hyperspectral, or \PMlinkexternal{Chemical NIR (IR) Imaging}{http://planetphysics.org/?op=getobj&from=lec&id=186} \item Nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, including FT-NMR, 2D-FT NMR and NMR Imaging \item Positron annihilation spectroscopy and imaging (PET scanning) \item Raman spectroscopy \item Resonance enhanced multiphoton ionization \item Rotational Microwave spectroscopy \item Terahertz spectroscopy \item Ultraviolet-visible spectroscopy \item Vibrational spectroscopy \item X-ray spectroscopy \end{itemize}
